project.name: cdm-samples
project.description: Canonical CDM sample instances used as shared test/demo fixtures across the reactor. Resource-only jar, no Java code. Depends on nothing — anyone can consume. Was previously mixed into rosetta-source/src/main/resources under the misleading `ingest/output/fpml-*` and `functions/fpml-5-10/*` paths; the segregation carve-out makes ownership explicit.
